name: Poison Breath (Recharge 5–6)
description: The creature exhales a 40-foot radius poison fog, which heavily obscures a spherical area around the creature. Any breathing creature that ends its turn in the fog must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1d4 + 1 rounds.
